reason: Three months free costs me nothing, and pay-at-table plus reviews only from guests who actually paid is something my place in Sololaki could use, with tourists waiting for the bill and leaving fake-looking reviews elsewhere. I'll put it on a few tables and see if guests use it before I pay a tetri.
objection: A new startup - will it still exist in a year, and who owns my guest data? If they fold or sell, I don't want my regulars' contacts walking out the door, and the payment partner's fee on top of every bill could eat more than the 59 lari.
would_change_my_mind: If the contract doesn't say in writing that the guest list is mine and I can export it any time, I walk away after the free months.
